Which skills each challenge actually tests

Every scored line in the 2026.2 rulebook, resolved through the canonical dictionary. Each skill is defined and priced once; challenges reference it by id. That makes two things visible for the first time: what capability areas a challenge really rewards, and where the same skill carries different prices in different tests.

Points by capability area

Reward and bonus points only; penalties and administrative lines excluded. Bar length is relative to the largest cell in the table. Click an area row or a challenge column to filter the table below; click again to clear.

Cross-challenge price drift

Skill families where variants used by different challenges carry different prices. These are not errors in the dictionary — they are what the rulebook says. The dictionary’s job is to make them visible so the TC can decide whether each spread is intended.
